summary: 不可逆・高影響操作だけを承認対象にし、それ以外はsandboxで自動化して承認疲れを減らす。PreToolUse hookとpermissions.denyで破壊的command（rm -rf、force push、prod deploy/migrate）を機械的に遮断し、branch rulesetsをAgentにも同一適用する

evidence.summary: PreToolUse exit 2/permissionDecision denyで確実に遮断、hookは単独でなくpermission systemと併用、ConfigChange hookで設定改変を監査/遮断、project hookはworkspace trust必要
Prompt fatigue mitigation: safe commandのallowlist、sandboxで自律範囲を定義しprompt削減、/permissions定期監査、managed settingsで組織強制
approval policy untrusted/on-request/never × sandbox modeの組合せ、.git read-only保護
rulesetsは複数重畳・最も厳しい規則適用・bypass listで例外を明示管理
tool call監査と反復・予算・時間limit、medium
ASI09 Human-Agent Trust Exploitation: 承認は内容拘束で、包括承認を避ける

destructive-command-guard (public, reputation unknown): read SKILL.md on skills.sh: DCG runs as a Claude Code PreToolUse hook, reads the Bash tool-call JSON on stdin and returns exit 2 to block, matches 49+ modular denial packs across git/filesystem/database/cloud, allows unrecognized commands by default, and offers a dcg scan subcommand for CI — the hook-and-deny half of this remedy.

applies_when: Agentがgit push、DB migration、deploy、削除を実行できる

expected_effect.primary: 無承認のhigh-risk action 0、承認回数の削減

risks: hookのpattern回避（別コマンド、script経由）
低risk操作まで承認すると形骸化
bypass listにAgent用bot/appを入れると迂回
known_failure_modes: 全操作への一般承認（局所cardの失敗対策）

matched_on: PreToolUse hook that blocks destructive Bash commands before execution
mechanical denial of rm -rf, git force push, and other high-impact patterns
whitelist-first so low-risk commands are not sent to approval
CI-side scan subcommand for the same patterns
